treatment.exact_text: Inspect linked material metaphors or images in the declared scope. Return YES only when the supplied artifact provides a concrete semantic hinge that makes their implications cohere: for example, a stated causal, temporal, role, or perspective relation, or a deliberately realized double meaning whose distinct readings are demonstrated in the artifact. An explicit connective, punctuation, or bare assertion that the images coexist is not itself a hinge. Return NO when opposing implications merely occur together without an additional artifact-grounded mechanism that reconciles, relates, or distinguishes them. Do not judge familiarity/defaultness or figurative density; cite the linked spans and the hinge, or the absence of one.
